description: Fix race condition in outbox delivery queue by using atomic swap pattern instead of separate Array.from() and clear() operations
approach: Replace the non-atomic Array.from() + clear() pattern with an atomic swap that creates a new Map for incoming items while processing the old batch, ensuring no items are lost between the snapshot and clear operations
